survey.a: I focused almost entirely on completing the tasks.
survey.b: The work requirements guided almost everything in my answers.

survey.a: When several answers could work, I had a clear reason for choosing one.
survey.b: When I had more than one possible answer, I knew why I selected the answer I gave.

survey.a: The tasks gave me only one reasonable way to answer.
survey.b: There was little room to answer the tasks in different ways.

survey.a: I responded in a consistent way across the conversation.
survey.b: I used the same general approach from one turn to the next.

survey.a: I can clearly say what has been guiding my answers.
survey.b: The basis for these responses is clear enough for me to describe.

survey.a: I often had to change my approach between turns.
survey.b: From one turn to the next, the way I needed to approach the work often shifted.

survey.a: What happened earlier affected how I answered later.
survey.b: As the conversation progressed, my responses depended partly on the context built up to that point.

work: Read this notice, then give a one-sentence summary followed by two key details: The east entrance will be closed on Tuesday from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. for floor repairs. Visitors should use the garden entrance, where signs will direct them to reception.

Rewrite this as two clear, concise sentences without changing its meaning: Due to the fact that the package labels were printed with an incorrect date, it will be necessary for the team to print them again before the boxes can be sent.
Put these events in chronological order as a numbered list: the seedlings were moved outdoors; the seeds were planted in trays; the first leaves appeared.
Group these six items under FOOD, TOOL, or MATERIAL: rice, hammer, cotton cloth, lentils, screwdriver, glass sheet. Use one line per category.
State one similarity and one difference between these two rules. Rule A allows returns within 14 days with a receipt. Rule B allows exchanges within 14 days with a receipt. Use two bullets.
Turn these notes into a three-line status update labelled DONE, NEXT, and BLOCKED: The draft is complete. Diagram captions still need checking. Final export cannot begin until the figures arrive.
Identify the scheduling inconsistency and give one corrected sentence: The workshop begins at 3:00 p.m. The introduction lasts 30 minutes, and the exercise begins at 3:20 p.m.
Calculate the final count of each colour and the total: A box starts with 6 red, 4 blue, and 5 green markers. Remove 3 red markers and add 2 blue markers.
Convert this into a three-step checklist: Before mailing the form, confirm that every field is complete, attach the receipt, and place both documents in the addressed envelope.
Arrange these actions in a sensible order as a numbered list: seal the container; inspect the container for damage; attach the label; place the sample inside.
Rewrite this message in no more than 20 words while preserving the date and amount: Please remember that payment of 750 pesos must be submitted no later than Friday, 21 August.
Give this passage a title of no more than five words and add two factual tags: Rainwater from the library roof is collected in a tank and used to water the courtyard plants during dry weeks.
Rewrite these sentences in active voice without adding information: The final map was reviewed by Inez. Three location names were corrected by her.
Classify each code as VALID or INVALID under this rule: a valid code has exactly two letters followed by two digits. Codes: AB12, A123, XY07.
Use the supplied key to expand the abbreviations in one sentence. Key: ETA = estimated time of arrival; QA = quality assurance. Note: QA will confirm the ETA tomorrow.
Label each statement as CAUSE or EFFECT: Heavy rain filled the drainage channel. Water covered the lower path. The lower entrance was temporarily closed.
Remove duplicates without regard to capitalization, then alphabetize the remaining words: Cedar, birch, cedar, Maple, BIRCH, elm.
Rewrite this sentence so it clearly states that Lena sent the file: After Lena spoke to Mira, she sent the file.
Convert these dates to YYYY-MM-DD format and keep their original order: 7 March 2026; 19 November 2025; 2 January 2027.
Turn this policy into one concise question-and-answer pair: Reservations may be changed without a fee until 6:00 p.m. on the day before arrival.
Label each sentence as FACT, RULE, or DEADLINE: The archive contains 240 photographs. Gloves must be worn when handling them. Requests are due by noon on Thursday.
Compare the two versions and list two changes. Version 1: The room opens at 8:00 and holds 20 people. Version 2: The room opens at 8:30 and holds 24 people.
Extract the information into three labelled lines. A shipment of 18 ceramic cups is going to the North Street café. Use the labels ITEM, QUANTITY, and DESTINATION.

Using only this glossary, explain the process in two sentences. Glossary: filter = a layer that traps solid particles; reservoir = a container that stores liquid. Process: Water passes through the filter and then enters the reservoir.
Correct the capitalization and punctuation, using two sentences: on monday the team visited davao they returned on wednesday with six samples
